meta.sourcing_rules: Primary sources only: utility CCR, municipal portals, USGS. No blogs or aggregators.
meta.band_scale: USGS: soft <60, moderately hard 61-120, hard 121-180, very hard >180 ppm CaCO3
meta.band_method: Midpoint for ranges; edge cases flagged when midpoint within 10 ppm of boundary
meta.url_rot_log: Of 30+ guessed CCR PDF URLs, ~80% were 404. WebSearch discovery found live URLs for most. PDF extraction via pymupdf succeeded where text-layer exists. Image-based CCR PDFs (Chicago, SAWS table pages) need manual review.
